retrievalProfile.description: A centered male portrait against a blurred architectural background with bold, top-aligned sans-serif typography featuring a horizontal color gradient.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a male subject with textured hair, positioned centrally against a high-contrast, teal-and-white architectural structure. The top third of the frame is dominated by two lines of sans-serif text, where the primary name features a metallic gold-to-white gradient.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's head overlaps the architectural mid-ground
Typography is anchored to the top-left and top-center
Cool-toned background contrasts with warm skin tones
Blurred background depth emphasizes the sharp foreground portrait
coreInvariants: High-contrast teal and white color palette in background
Bold, geometric sans-serif for the primary name

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bold, gradient-filled primary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the architectural lines into the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper corners and the blurred architectural arches.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between dark shadows and bright highlights; background is desaturated teal while the subject has natural warmth.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool blues and teals for environment

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for secondary text
Heavy, blocky proportions for primary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Primary text features a linear horizontal gradient from white to gold
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast: Ultra-light condensed paired with ultra-bold geometric.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy geometric structure of the primary name.
Provides a similar classic American sans-serif feel.
Matches the secondary text's thin, airy quality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium close-up portrait of a man with curly hair and stubble, looking slightly off-camera. The background should be a blurred, high-contrast architectural structure with teal-colored arches and white stone, under a dark, moody sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text at the top. The top line should be a thin, light-colored sans-serif in lowercase. The bottom line should be a large, bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif with a horizontal gradient from white on the left to gold on the right.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text bold and uppercase?
Does the primary text have a white-to-gold gradient?
Is the background architectural and teal-toned?
Is the subject's face in sharp focus compared to the background?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific artist name or album title
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the artist

mustAchieve: Effective use of depth of field
Balanced color contrast between warm skin and cool background

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the dark background
Ensure the gradient transition is smooth
Confirm the teal/cyan color cast in the background
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Blurred Architectural Background + Top-Aligned Bold Gradient Typography
